rationale: PINS GO38 in BOTH directions, because the fix moved a gate and the gate's other half is what a future editor would break. LocalsAreNotSymbols (C# M12.07 / Swift M12.21) excludes a function-local var/const; the family's stated exception is nim's, in its own analyzer header — 'THE ONE EXCEPTION IS AN OBJECT/ENUM/FIELD DECLARATION, WHICH IS A SYMBOL BECAUSE THE OBJECT OWNS IT.' A local type owns its fields, so the type is a declaration and the fields are members. PRE-FIX the walk `continue`d on every function and method and never reached a local type at all, and the silence was NOT neutral: `extractDeclaredTypeRefs` already walks bodies and already attributed a local type's field types to that type, so the lane published `references Local -> Host` with `Local` absent from its own symbol table — a relationship whose SOURCE named nothing. Found by the round-6 `contains` truth (`go-round6-contains-truth.ts`), which derives membership from the DECLARATION side of the tree so an unpublished type is a MISSING row rather than invisible on both sides; 22 such memberships in 200 go-tools files (0.07% of the surface, which is why a 60-file draw could not see it). The FORBID rows are the other half of the contract: publishing everything in a body would satisfy the expect rows too, so without them this fixture cannot tell the fix from its opposite. All values read from the real emission by `script/m14/tmp/go-round5-fixture-dump.ts`-style probing after the fix, never predicted.
